newsitem.title: USA: Tigera to change name, stock split.
newsitem.headline: Tigera to change name, stock split.

text.p: Tigera Group Inc said shareholders approved a name change to Connectivity Technologies Inc and said a one-for-four reverse stock split will take effect at the opening of trading on Monday.
Connectivity will have the new trading symbol CVTK.OB. Tigera trades under the symbol "TYGRA" on the OTC bulletin board.
Monday's reverse split will reduce the number of shares outstanding to 5.6 million from 22.3 million shares.
The company distributes and manufactures wire and cable products.
